channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: NFL: Puka Nacua oo qalliin jilibka loogu sameeyay, Rams-na bilooyin ayuu ka maqnaan doonaa
item.description: Tababaraha Los Angeles Rams Sean McVay ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in xiddigga kooxda Puka Nacua qalliin loogu sameeyay seedda MCL ee jilibka, uuna ka maqnaan doono garoonka muddo labo bilood ah.

item.title: Kenya: FKF iyo Darajani Gogo oo heshiis gaaray, horyaalka NSL-na wuxuu bilaabmayaa toddobaadka soo socda
item.description: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Kenya (FKF) iyo kooxda Darajani Gogo ayaa heshiis gaaray kaas oo u oggolaanaya in xilli ciyaareedka 2026/27 ee horyaalka heerka labaad ee National Super League (NSL) uu bilaabmo toddobaadka soo socda.

item.title: Koobka Adduunka U17: Talyaaniga oo 6-0 ku jebiyay Jamaica kulankiisii ugu horreeyay
item.description: Xulka Talyaaniga ee da'da ka yar 17 sano ayaa Jimcihii 6-0 kaga adkaaday Jamaica kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee Koobka Adduunka ee ka socda Qatar.

item.title: MADASHA SAMATABIXINTA OO MAANTA HOTEL JAZEERA KU YEELANAYSA KULAN MUHIIM AH OO KU SAABSAN FARRIINTA MADAXWEYNAHA
item.description: Muqdisho – Madasha Samatabixinta ayaa maanta kulan muhiim ah ku yeelanaysa Hotel Jazeera ee magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo ka tashiga farriin uu dhawaan soo diray Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kuna saabsan gogosha wadahadalka siyaasadeed ee uu ku baaqay.

item.title: Duqa New York Zohran Mamdani oo seedda Achilles ka jaray isagoo kubadda cagta ciyaaraya
item.description: Duqa magaalada New York Zohran Mamdani ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu seedda Achilles ka jaray kulan saaxiibtinimo oo kubadda cagta ah oo uu Khamiistii ciyaaray, wuxuuna ku yimid shir jaraa'id isagoo ku tiirsan ulo.

item.title: Uganda oo baarlamaanka ka codsatay ogolaansho deyn Shs530 bilyan ah oo waddooyin lagu dhiso
item.description: Dowladda Uganda ayaa baarlamaanka ka codsatay inuu u oggolaado deyn gaaraysa Shs530 bilyan oo laga qaadanayo Citi Bank, si loo laamiyo 78.4 kiilomitir oo waddooyin ah oo ku yaalla degmooyinka Kanungu iyo Rubanda.

item.title: MotoGP Portugal: Álex Márquez oo hoggaamiyay tijaabada Portimão, Marc Márquez oo Sabtida horyaal noqon kara
item.description: Álex Márquez ayaa Jimcihii ugu dhaqsiyo badnaa tijaabada kahor isreebreebka Grand Prix-ga Portugal ee Portimão, halka walaalkiis Marc Márquez uu Sabtida ku guuleysan karo horyaalkiisa tobnaad ee adduunka.

item.title: Omar Berrada: Qaar ka mid ah dhaleeceynta taageerayaasha Man United waxay dhaafeen xadka
item.description: Maamulaha guud ee Manchester United Omar Berrada ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah dhaleeceynta loo jeediyay hoggaanka kooxda ay ka gudubtay xadka, inkastoo uu fahmayo xanaaqa taageerayaasha.

item.title: Tennis: Carlos Alcaraz oo aan weli go'aamin inuu ka qeybgalo Davis Cup-ka
item.description: Xiddigga tennis-ka Spain Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuusan weli go'aan ka gaarin inuu ka ciyaari doono Davis Cup-ka toddobaadyada soo socda, isagoo ammaanay xoogga xulka Jarmalka ee uu hoggaaminayo Alexander Zverev.

item.title: Koobka Adduunka U17: Spain oo 5-0 ku garaacday China, Tunkara oo gool qurux badan dhaliyay
item.description: Xulka Spain ee da'da ka yar 17 sano ayaa Jimcihii 5-0 kaga adkaaday China kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee Koobka Adduunka ee ka socda Doha.

item.title: Ruto oo difaacay guddiga doorashooyinka IEBC, mucaaradkana ku baaqay inay keenaan siyaasado kale
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Jimcaha weerar culus ku qaaday hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ee dalabyo ka keenay guddiga madaxa-bannaan ee doorashooyinka iyo xuduudaha (IEBC), isagoo ku eedeeyay inay faragelin ku sameynayaan hay'adda.

item.title: Everton: Jack Grealish oo dib ugu soo laabtay kooxda ka hor kulanka Brentford
item.description: Tababaraha Everton David Moyes ayaa xaqiijiyay in Jack Grealish uu diyaar u yahay safarka kooxda ee Brentford Isniinta, kadib muddo uu kooxda kaga maqnaa arrin anshax.

item.title: Denmark oo sirdoonka Ruushka ku eedeysay shirqool lagu doonayay in lagu dilo fanaan Ukrainian ah
item.description: Xafiiska Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Denmark ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in mas'uuliyiintu ay fashiliyeen isku day dil oo dhulka Denmark lagaga dhan ahaa muwaadin Ukrainian ah oo haysta dhalashada Mareykanka, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay in uu abaabulay sirdoonka Ruushka.

item.title: Bologna: Palladino oo Heggem ka saaray liiska kulanka Udinese kadib hadalladiisii ku saabsanaa ka tagista
item.description: Tababaraha Bologna Raffaele Palladino ayaa sheegay inuusan daafaca reer Norway Heggem u yeeri doonin kulanka Udinese, kadib markii ciyaartoygu si cad u sheegay inuu ka daalay inuu kursiga keydka ku fadhiisto.

item.title: Pochettino oo Man United ka dalbaday inuu cod ku yeesho dhammaan go'aannada waaweyn ee kooxda koowaad
item.description: Tababaraha cusub ee Manchester United Mauricio Pochettino ayaa hoggaanka kooxda u sheegay inuu doonayo inuu ka qayb qaato dhammaan go'aannada muhiimka ah ee la xiriira kooxda koowaad.

item.title: Celtic oo dhaawac culus ku waayay Mika Baur, kaas oo ilaa 10 toddobaad maqnaan doona
item.description: Khadka dhexe ee Celtic Mika Baur ayaa la filayaa inuu ugu yaraan 10 toddobaad ka maqnaado garoonka, kadib dhaawac soo gaaray seedaha canqowga.

item.title: Como: Fabregas oo sheegay in Moise Kean uu bilooyin ka maqnaan doono garoonka
item.description: Tababaraha Como Cesc Fabregas ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in weeraryahanka Talyaaniga Moise Kean uu bilooyin dhowr ah ka maqnaan doono kulamada, kadib dhibaato lafeed oo uu ku qabsaday tababarka.

item.title: Chelsea: João Pedro oo ka maqnaan doona kulanka Leeds, Xabi Alonso oo ciyaartoyda ugu baaqay inay kor u kacaan
item.description: Tababaraha Chelsea Xabi Alonso ayaa Jimcihii xaqiijiyay in weeraryahanka João Pedro uusan diyaar u ahayn kulanka Leeds United, isagoo ciyaartoyda kale ugu baaqay inay buuxiyaan kaalinta dhaawacyadu ka tageen.

item.title: MotoGP: Maverick Viñales oo ka baxay Grand Prix-ga Portugal, Pol Espargaró oo beddelay
item.description: Darawalka kooxda KTM Tech3 Maverick Viñales ayaa go'aansaday inuusan sii wadin Grand Prix-ga Portugal ee Portimão, waxaana booskiisa la galiyay Pol Espargaró.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Golaha Wasiirrada oo ansixiyay iibsashada 200,000 tan oo cunto ah si loola tacaalo gaajada
item.description: Golaha Wasiirrada Koonfur Suudaan, oo uu shir guddoominayay Madaxweyne Salva Kiir, ayaa Jimcihii ansixiyay in la iibsado lana kaydiyo 200,000 tan oo cunto ah, iyadoo cunto-yaraantu saameysay in ka badan 7 milyan oo qof.

item.title: Isbahaysiga Sacuudiga oo duqeeyay dekedda Xudeyda iyo Sanca, Xuutiyiintuna ku hanjabeen dekedaha Sacuudiga
item.description: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudi Carabiya hoggaamiyo ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu howlgal gaar ah ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta ka fuliyay Yemen, isagoo duqeeyay xarumo ku yaal dekedda Xudeyda iyo bakhaarro hub oo ku yaal caasimadda Sanca, halka Xuutiyiintu ay xarunta maaliyadda ee Riyadh iyo dekedaha Badda Cas ee Sacuudiga ku tilmaameen bartilmaameed militari.

item.title: Maresca oo sheegay in kiiska Premier League aanu saameyn ku yeelan qaabka Manchester City kadib 3 guuldarro oo isku xiga
item.description: Tababaraha Manchester City Enzo Maresca ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in kiiska ay Premier League kula jirto kooxda aanu sabab u ahayn qaabka hooseeya ee kooxda, kadib markii ay 3 kulan oo horyaal ah oo isku xiga lumisay.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Kiir oo isu diiwaangeliyay codbixiye, SPLM-IO-na diiday dib u dhigista doorashada
item.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Suudaan Salva Kiir ayaa Jimcihii magaalada Juba isu diiwaangeliyay codbixiye, isla maalintaas oo xisbiga mucaaradka SPLM-IO uu diiday go'aanka guddiga doorashooyinka ee doorashada lagu dib u dhigay ilaa 11 February 2027.

item.title: Tanzania: Madaxweyne Samia oo sheegtay in dhawaan la dhisayo guddi dib-u-heshiisiin qaran, dastuur cusubna la qorayo
item.description: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa Jimcihii magaalada Moshi ku sheegtay in dhawaan la dhisi doono Guddiga Dib-u-heshiisiinta Qaranka, kaas oo loo igmaday inuu xoojiyo midnimada isla markaana u gogol xaaro qorista dastuur cusub.

item.title: Kenya: Guddiga AFCON 2027 oo beeniyay in tikidhada kulanka Bayern iyo Ajax ee Talanta si jumlad ah loo iibsaday
item.description: Agaasimaha guud ee Guddiga Abaabulka Maxalliga ah ee Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027, Anthony Lung'aho, ayaa Jimcihii beeniyay sheegashooyin ah in dad gaar ah ay si jumlad ah u iibsadeen tikidhada kulanka saaxiibtinimo ee Bayern Munich iyo Ajax ee lagu ciyaari doono garoonka Talanta ee Nairobi.

item.title: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya oo ka qayb galay shirka Waqooyiga Yurub iyo Afrika ee Oslo
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, ayaa ka qayb galay shirka wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee waddamada Waqooyiga Yurub iyo Afrika oo 19 ilaa 20 November ka dhacay magaalada Oslo ee dalka Norway.

item.title: Barcelona oo si rasmi ah heshiis cusub ula saxiixatay Xavi Espart ilaa 2030
item.description: FC Barcelona ayaa Jimcihii si rasmi ah u kordhisay heshiiska ciyaartoyga da'da yar Xavi Espart, kaas oo hadda kooxda la joogaya ilaa 2030.

item.title: PSG: Luis Enrique oo sheegay in Ousmane Dembélé uu ku soo laaban karo kulanka Nice ee Sabtida
item.description: Tababaraha Paris Saint-Germain Luis Enrique ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Ousmane Dembélé, oo ku guuleystay Ballon d'Or 2025, uu ku soo laaban karo kooxda toddobaadkan kadib dhaawac muddo ku maqnaa.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Villa Somalia ku qaabilay wafdi UK ah oo kala hadlay khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo amniga
item.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Jimcihii Muqdisho ku qaabilay saraakiil sare oo ka socday dowladda UK, kuwaas oo kala hadlay xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee dalka xilli dadaallo loogu jiro in dowladda iyo mucaaradku heshiis ka gaaraan doorashooyinka.

item.title: Southampton oo heshiis ilaa 2029 ah siisay tababare Tonda Eckert inkastoo uu ku lug lahaa fadeexaddii 'Spygate'
item.description: Kooxda Southampton ee ka ciyaarta Championship-ka Ingiriiska ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday in tababaraheeda Tonda Eckert uu saxiixay heshiis cusub oo kooxda ku haynaya ilaa 2029.
